galbot.description: Develops embodied models for manipulation and mobile tasks in settings such as retail and material handling. Its developer platform provides perception, planning, control, navigation, and simulation resources.

agibot.description: Develops humanoid robots and embodied AI models, with the open AgiBot World manipulation dataset, models, and development tools.

unitree.description: Develops quadruped and humanoid robots, including G1 and H1 platforms used for locomotion research. Unitree RL Gym provides tools for reinforcement-learning training and deployment.

sudo.research: The website provides a technical explanation and a continuous 60-minute picking video, including moving targets, mid-grasp disturbances, and obstacle avoidance in constrained spaces.

tars.research: WIYH covers data capture, annotation, and skill transfer. The AWE series focuses on vision–touch fusion and precise contact manipulation, including flexible wiring assembly.

roboticsIntro: Robotics research spans training in simulation, learning from human demonstrations, general-purpose models, adapting skills, and control on real hardware.
